How Plants Make Food

Plants make their own food in a process called photosynthesis.

What plants need

A plant needs sunlight, water and carbon dioxide.

  • Sunlight is caught by the leaves.
  • Water comes up from the roots.

The role of chlorophyll

Chlorophyll is the green substance
that absorbs light.

What plants make

Plants make sugar for energy and give off oxygen.
